sense.text:
Whatever is written in the Bible was written for us. Paul reveals it: “whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.” The histories, the prophecies, the empires in the scriptures were put there for us to learn from, and it says the same thing as Ecclesiastes 1:9, read the week before.

So it behooves us to read, read, and read more. The hope comes “through patience and comfort of the scriptures.”

The Latins gave the name Africa to the region around Carthage and Utica. The Latins became the Roman Empire, and they are the ones that put the name Africa on the continent. The Latins were Edom, and they took over Japheth and the Roman Republic.

Ezra saw it in a dream: “there came up from the sea an eagle, which had twelve feathered wings, and three heads.” This eagle is the fourth empire, Rome. Chapter 11 is the vision Ezra had, and chapter 12 is the interpretation of what he saw. The two chapters go together, and chapter 12 shows the twelve feathered wings are twelve kings, the twelve Caesars.
“out of her feathers there grew other contrary feathers; and they became little feathers and small.” Out of the twelve feathers grew up contrary feathers, little and small.
“But her heads were at rest”: the three heads were at rest, and “the head in the midst was greater than the other, yet rested it with the residue.”

“the eagle flew with her feathers, and reigned upon earth, and over them that dwelt therein.” Everything was subject to this eagle with three heads: “all things under heaven were subject unto her, and no man spake against her”. Nobody could come against the eagle, it was so powerful, “no, not one creature upon earth”, not one creature could come against this fourth empire.

precepts.why:
Chapter 11 is answered in chapter 12: “This is the interpretation of the vision: The eagle, whom thou sawest come up from the sea, is the kingdom which was seen in the vision of thy brother Daniel. But it was not expounded unto him, therefore now I declare it unto thee.” Daniel saw the fourth kingdom, but he never understood that the fourth kingdom upon the earth would be represented by the eagle. What was never explained to Daniel is declared to Ezra.

“Behold, the days will come, that there shall rise up a kingdom upon earth, and it shall be feared above all the kingdoms that were before it. In the same shall twelve kings reign, one after another”. The twelve feathers, the twelve wings of chapter 11, are twelve kings: the twelve Caesars.

“Whereof the second shall begin to reign, and shall have more time than any of the twelve”: the one that reigned longest was Augustus Caesar, the second. “And this do the twelve wings signify, which thou sawest.”

This is what Daniel saw that was never explained to him: “four great beasts came up from the sea, diverse one from another.” “The first was like a lion, and had eagle’s wings”: that is the Babylonian empire, Babylon.

“another beast, a second, like to a bear, and it raised up itself on one side, and it had three ribs in the mouth of it”: that is the Persian Media empire. It was first called the Medo-Persian Empire, then the Persian-Medes Empire, because the Persians became greater than the Medes. The three ribs are Egypt, Ethiopia and Seba.

“another, like a leopard”: the Greeks. “which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl”: four major armies from the four generals. “the beast had also four heads”: the generals themselves, Ptolemy, Cassander and Lysimachus among them. “and dominion was given to it.”

Then “a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly; and it had great iron teeth”. Babylon is given the lion, Persia and Media the bear, the Greeks the leopard, but this fourth one is not given an animal symbol. It “was diverse from all the beasts that were before it; and it had ten horns.” That is the kingdom 2 Esdras says was not expounded to Daniel: the fourth kingdom is the eagle.

sense.text:
“on the right side there arose one feather, and reigned over all the earth”: that is Julius Caesar, who reigned 49 BC to 44 BC. The histories call him dictator of the Roman Republic, not dictator of the Roman Empire, and the Roman Republic and the Roman Empire were two separate empires: the Roman Republic was Japheth, the Roman Empire Esau. Julius was the last dictator of the Roman Republic, but he was also the beginning of the Roman Empire. They say Augustus founded it; the Bible shows it began with Julius, the first feather.

And Julius Caesar was not Japheth. Dr. William Smith's Dictionary of the Bible (1896) records that from Edom proceeded the kings who reigned in Italy and built up Rome to be great among the nations, so that Italy and Greece and all the western provinces became filled with Idumeans, and the prophets call the whole of that nation by the name of Edom. So Greece was Idumeans and the Roman Empire was Idumeans. Kimchi, on Joel 3:10, says Julius Caesar was an Idumean, an Edomite. And the Jews, ancient and modern, believed Titus was an Edomite, so that when the prophets denounced Edom they referred it to Titus.

“when it reigned, the end of it came, and the place thereof appeared no more”: Julius got assassinated, put to death. Then “the next following stood up”, “and had a great time”: that is Augustus Caesar, born 63 BC, who reigned 27 BC to 14 AD, about 41 years, called in the histories the founder of the Roman Empire.
Augustus died also, “like as the first, so that it appeared no more.”

A voice came to Augustus: “Hear thou that hast borne rule over the earth so long”, because he reigned 41 years. “There shall none after thee attain unto thy time, neither unto the half thereof”: before he began to die, it was told him that no Caesar after him would reign as long as Augustus Caesar.

“Then arose the third”, a third Caesar, a third wing, “and reigned as the other before, and appeared no more also.” That is Tiberius, born 42 BC, who reigned 14 AD to 37 AD: the stepson of Augustus, a reclusive yet effective military general.

“So went it with all the residue one after another, as that every one reigned, and then appeared no more.” There were twelve in all: Julius, Augustus, Tiberius, Caligula, Claudius, Nero, Galba, Otho, Vitellius, Vespasian, Titus and Domitian.

Caligula, the fourth, reigned 37 to 41 AD, the first Roman emperor to be assassinated; his reign covers roughly Acts 7, the death of Stephen, through early Acts 12. Claudius was the fifth and Nero the sixth. Galba, the seventh, imposed heavy taxes on the districts opposing his rule. Otho, the eighth, reckless and extravagant, ruled only a few months, and Vitellius, the ninth, about six months, unambitious and self-indulgent, executed by Vespasian's soldiers.

Vespasian, the tenth, reigned 69 to 79 AD, so he was the Caesar when they destroyed Jerusalem in 70 AD. He founded the Flavian dynasty, their family name: Flavius Josephus was their slave, captured in the war and used as a translator between Rome and the Hebrews. The Colosseum, the Flavian Amphitheater, was begun under Vespasian and finished by his son Titus, and they used thousands of the Jews they had captured, black slaves, to build it. The hundred days of games that opened it was us inside the Colosseum fighting tigers and lions and bears: the gladiators were us. After the war Jews were set against wild beasts, and 2,500 Jews were killed by beasts or burned alive; some of us they had on crosses and set on fire while the rest fought animals or each other. Those Jews were us at that time. The pictures show the gladiator with an afro fighting a bear, and another fighting a bull, and Africans boxing: those were still the Jews, put in sports to fight each other, sport for the white man. That is the origin of boxing that some of you love so much.

Titus, the eleventh feather, reigned 79 to 81 AD. Left in charge of the war in Judaea, he began the siege of Jerusalem in May AD 70, and four months later the city fell, leveled, the temple destroyed. Titus was thought profligate, cruel, immoral, homosexual and greedy. Domitian, the twelfth and last feather, reigned 81 to 96 AD, a totalitarian who ruled fifteen years, and John the Revelator died around his time, in 96 AD.

precepts.why:
Augustus, the second feather, is named in the scriptures: “there went out a decree from Cesar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.” “And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.” You thought taxation started with America. No, it started with Rome. Everything America does is based on ancient Rome.

Joseph went up to Bethlehem “To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child”: they filed jointly. So the brothers or sisters who say we're sovereign and don't have to pay taxes are going to get themselves jacked up, and any dummy that listens to them.

“Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Cesar”. Luke 2:1 names Caesar Augustus, then Luke 3:1 names Tiberius: these are the feathers read about in Esdras.

Tiberius, reigning AD 14 to 37, was the emperor during the crucifixion, AD 30 or 33, and from Acts 1 to about Acts 9 or 10: the establishment of the church at Pentecost, its early growth in Jerusalem, and the first persecution. That is the time Christ was an adult, so when you read the four Gospels, it is Tiberius who was the Caesar of the time.

Claudius, the fifth Caesar, reigned 41 AD to 54 AD. Paul found Aquila and Priscilla “lately come from Italy”, “because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome”. That is Claudius Caesar, around AD 49 to 50.

People say the Bible is not a history book, yet it gives you the Caesars, all in there.

Agabus “signified by the spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Cesar.” Claudius was not Caesar when this was spoken in Acts 11; Caligula was ruling. Claudius came into power four or five years later, and that is when the famine hit, around AD 45 to 46.

This is why, when we tell you to prepare, you have to listen closely. Black people say, well, it didn't happen this year or next, so it ain't going to happen. This famine didn't occur for five years, but it came.

Nero, the sixth Caesar, reigned AD 54 to 68, over the last chapters of Acts, about 25 through 28. His name is not found in the scriptures, but he is the Caesar Paul appeals to: “I stand at Cesar’s judgment seat, where I ought to be judged”, “I appeal unto Cesar.” And Festus answered, “Hast thou appealed unto Cesar? unto Cesar shalt thou go.” Put Nero, Nero Caesar, in your Bible there.

Nero is the one who burned down Rome and blamed it on the black Christians. That is where the CD-burning software of the '90s got the name Nero, with Rome on fire for its symbol.

Paul found it better to be judged by the white man than by wicked Israelites, because those Jews, those Pharisees, wanted Paul put to death. He would rather have a better judgment dealing with white folks than dealing with his own black brothers.
“And Paul dwelt two whole years in his own hired house, and received all that came in unto him”. Nero was emperor while Paul was in prison in Rome, so this takes place under Nero, the sixth feather.

“And unto the angel of the church in Smyrna write; These things saith the first and the last, which was dead, and is alive”. Smyrna is in Asia Minor, where Jewish settlement is recorded first in the time of Antiochus III, and where Paul went, with Ephesus, Philippi, Colossae and Corinth.

A bas-relief from Smyrna of the 3rd century AD shows prisoners in chains: two brothers with afros, yokes of iron on their necks, dragged by a Roman. Those were the Jews that were there in Smyrna, our brothers, under Rome.

sense.text: “the eight small under feathers sticking to her wings”: after the twelve came eight small feathers. Five are the five good emperors, 96 to 180 AD: Nerva, Trajan, Hadrian, Antoninus Pius and Marcus Aurelius. Then Lucius Verus and Commodus, and the eighth is Septimius Severus. Write those names down.

“That in him there shall arise eight kings, whose times shall be but small, and their years swift.” The eighth, Septimius Severus, was called the African, and this is what made him contrary: he was the first black Caesar, Rome's first African emperor, because he wasn't of the race of Edom. His rule was a paradox: egotistical, rude and crude, but shrewd; he militarized the government and launched treasury-draining wars abroad.

Yet Septimius held to the same dictates of Rome. In AD 197, at the beginning of his reign, he declared war against the Samaritans and the Jews, his own people, because they were keeping the commandments. After 70 AD there were laws that forbade us to go back to Jerusalem, the homeland, and Septimius kept that law going. When Pescennius Niger, who was also black, competed for the throne, Septimius rewarded the Jews and Samaritans for their loyalty with the privileges of Roman citizens. And he married a white woman.
“And two of them shall perish, the middle time approaching”: the two that perished, and died, are Pertinax and Didius. Write those two names down.

precepts.why:
Septimius married a white woman, and Tobit speaks to interracial marriage: “Beware of all whoredom, my son, and chiefly take a wife of the seed of thy fathers, and take not a strange woman to wife, which is not of thy father’s tribe”. God calls taking a strange woman to wife whoredom. “for we are the children of the prophets”, and “our fathers from the beginning, even that they all married wives of their own kindred, and were blessed in their children, and their seed shall inherit the land.”

“Now therefore, my son, love thy brethren, and despise not in thy heart thy brethren, the sons and daughters of thy people, in not taking a wife of them”. It is hatred when you don't take a wife of your own people. “for in pride is destruction and much trouble”: you've got pride when you say, I don't want the black woman, I don't want an Israelite woman, I want a strange woman.

“and in lewdness is decay and great want”: when they divorce your black behind, they take everything you got. Just ask Kanye; ask all these athletes that married strange wives. Tiger Woods did it; Young Jeezy married the Chinese woman. As soon as she gets mad, she takes half of everything you got and gives it home to daddy. You thought you were on a high horse.

sense.text: “As for the voice which thou heardest speak, and that thou sawest not to go out from the heads, but from the midst of the body thereof”: Ezra heard a voice coming from the eagle, but it was not the heads of the eagle speaking. The voice came from the body. That is the deep state, the shadow government, as they call it: people in the background running things.

“That after the time of that kingdom there shall arise great strivings, and it shall stand in peril of falling: nevertheless it shall not then fall”: Rome would not fall at that time, “but shall be restored again to his beginning.” Remember that: restored again to his beginning is the Renaissance, and it is Revelation 13:3.

“And two of them shall perish”: the two that perished are Publius Helvius Pertinax and Marcus Didius Severus Julianus. Not Diddy: Didius. Pertinax reigned only 87 days in 193 AD before the Praetorian Guard assassinated him, because he tried to reform the military and crack down on corruption, and the imperial throne was put up for auction. Didius Julianus bought the throne from the Praetorian Guard and reigned only 66 days, executed in the palace by an assassin sent by his successor, Septimius Severus.

“the middle time approaching”: the Middle Ages were approaching. This was the time of Septimius Severus, around 193 AD.

precepts.why:
“Was not Esau Jacob’s brother? saith the Lord: yet I loved Jacob, And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.” The Roman emperors were all Esau, except Septimius Severus.

“Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished”: when? The Dark Ages, the Middle Ages, the middle time approaching of 2 Esdras 12:21, when Septimius Severus took over. In the beginning, in Genesis 36, they were the dukes of Edom; they were rich. But here Edom says, we are impoverished.

“but we will return and build the desolate places”: when did they return? The Renaissance, around 1453. From the time of the Renaissance until now, Esau has built the desolate places.

“They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness”: Esau, Edom, is the border of wickedness, “and, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.” The Lord has righteous anger against them forever.

sense.text:
“a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns”. The seven heads are Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia and Great Britain. The ten horns are Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Germany, the United Kingdom, Italy, Greece, France, Denmark and Ireland.

“and upon his heads the name of blasphemy”: Jesus is white; Sunday worship; man and man marriage, female and female marriage; the woman over the man; changing the names of the months to Roman gods; the Jews are white; God is white; Jerusalem belongs to the white man. All of those are blasphemies.

“like unto a leopard”: in Daniel 7 the leopard was the Greeks. This kingdom is not of the Greeks, but in these last days it has elements of ancient Greece in its system. “his feet were as the feet of a bear”: the bear was the Medo-Persian Empire, already conquered, so this last empire has elements of the ancient Medes and Persians; there are elements of it here in America. “his mouth as the mouth of a lion”: the lion was Babylon, conquered by Persia and Media, so this last empire has elements of Babylon in it.

“and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority”: this last kingdom was given power by Satan.

“I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death”: Rome, the Roman Empire, was wounded to death when Septimius took it over, in the Dark Ages. “and his deadly wound was healed”: Rome came back in 1453, the Renaissance. That is what Malachi said: we are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places. “and all the world wondered after the beast.”

“another beast coming up out of the earth”: this is America. “he had two horns like a lamb”: the two horns are the Republicans and the Democrats, a bipartisan system, and like a lamb because they say this is a Christian country, founded on Judeo-Christian ideals. “and he spake as a dragon”, because they talk of war, death and destruction.

On the dollar bill the eagle holds the olive branch, peace, and the arrows, how they conquered with war. They came saying they had peace, like a lamb, but war was in their hearts, and they came and destroyed our people.

“he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him”: America exercises all the power of the first beast, Rome. Look at the dollar bill: annuit coeptis and novus ordo seclorum are Latin from ancient Rome; the numerals for 1776 at the bottom of the pyramid come from Rome; e pluribus unum, out of many, one, is Latin from Rome. Out of many nations came one: the United States of America. The Capitol and the White House are Roman architecture, and the Vatican has the same, which is why they call themselves the Roman Catholic Church.

“and causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed”: the gods they have are Rome's. At the Vatican, the statues of Peter, James, John, Isaiah and Malachi were, as even the tour guide said, originally ancient Roman gods. They didn't want to tear them down, so they changed the names, from a Zeus to a Peter. Everything is based on ancient Rome.
“as it were a roaring lion chased out of the wood”: the lion represents Christ. “he sent out a man’s voice unto the eagle”: Christ is speaking to this eagle with twelve feathers.

“Art not thou it that remainest of the four beasts, whom I made to reign in my world”: Christ is the one that gave them the power. “that the end of their times might come through them?” Nobody rules unless Christ allows it, unless the Lord allows it. Satan gave them power because Christ said it is their turn to rule.

“And the fourth came, and overcame all the beasts that were past”: this fourth beast is the same one read in Daniel 7, after Babylon, Persia and Media, and Greece: Rome.

Netanyahu, reading Barry Strauss's book on the Jews against Rome, said, we lost that one; we have to win the next one, and they call the United States the new Rome, the empire with the greatest power in the world today. They say they lost in 70 AD, but that wasn't them. That's us. They love taking our history. Many of them know America is the new Rome.

“and had power over the world with great fearfulness, and over the whole compass of the earth”: from Rome to America they rule over all the earth, as the map of America's navy bases shows. From Rome to the United States of America they have ruled and dominated collectively, “with much wicked oppression; and so long time dwelt he upon the earth with deceit.”

Judas Maccabeus had heard of the Romans, “that they were mighty and valiant men, and such as would lovingly accept all that joined themselves unto them, and make a league of amity with all that came unto them”. The Maccabees were around 167 or 168 BC, and the Roman Republic ran from 509 BC, when the last Etruscan king was deposed, to 27 BC. So 1 Maccabees 8 is the Roman Republic: this is Japheth, the seat of Japheth at that time.

They always say Augustus started the Roman Empire, but it was really Julius Caesar. He was at the end of the Roman Republic and he passed the mantle to Augustus. When you read the Bible, it tells you Julius Caesar was the beginning of the Roman Empire, regardless of what Google says.

“Also that, whom they would help to a kingdom, those reign; and whom again they would, they displace”: this is about coups d'état, and America took it from ancient Rome. They say, I'm going to make you the prime minister, the king, the president. And when they don't like your policies anymore, they overthrow you and put somebody else in your place. Today they call it regime change.

In 1953 President Dwight Eisenhower authorized the CIA-backed coup, Operation Ajax, that overthrew Iran's prime minister Mohammad Mosaddegh, who had nationalized the Anglo-Iranian Oil Company, now BP, and wanted to keep the money for the people of Iran. They said he was a communist; now they say weapons of mass destruction. They put in their man, the Shah, Mohammad Reza Pahlavi, America's friend, and he signed over 40% of Iran's oil fields to US companies. He was ruthless and extravagant, flying lunch in from Paris every day while his wife took milk baths, and the Iranians overthrew him in the 1979 revolution, fueled by resentment over the 1953 coup. Now they want his son, Reza Pahlavi, the crown prince, for the new regime change: a puppet just like his father was a puppet.

In the 1979 hostage crisis, Ayatollah Khomeini ordered the black hostages, black men and women, released early, saying they were not spies and were already victims of injustice in America. The movie Argo leaves that out and concentrates on the six in the Canadian ambassador's home, because they want black people to think, we're with you, we're all together.

This is how they destabilize countries: they pay a couple hundred people, money is no object, give them weapons, and the news in the West shows you those protesters while millions love their government. That is why Trump kept telling the people of Iran, overthrow your government. In 2004 Haiti's President Aristide was kidnapped, forced to resign and exiled by the US and France after demanding $21 billion in reparations from France: the same thing they did with Maduro in Venezuela. Saddam Hussein worked for America, who put him in power, until he said, this is our oil; then he was a terrorist with weapons of mass destruction they never found. Manuel Noriega worked for America until Panama wanted to keep the canal. Gaddafi was America's guy too, until he expelled the foreign military bases, nationalized the oil, gave his people a house when they married, and wanted one currency and one visa for all Africa. Then they paid rebels to go against him, NATO drones hit his convoy, and he was dragged from a drainage pipe and murdered, the same as they did to Patrice Lumumba. Look at Libya with Gaddafi and Libya with American democracy.

And some of you, in here and online, were cheering: yeah, those are evil people. What did he do to you? Did he put chains on you? Read a book. Travel. Talk to the people.

“Yet for all this none of them wore a crown, or was clothed in purple, to be magnified thereby: Moreover how they had made for themselves a senate house”: the Roman Republic had a senate house, and this is where America gets it from, Rome. Theirs had “three hundred and twenty men sat in council daily, consulting alway for the people”; America's senate has a hundred, two from each state.

“And that they committed their government to one man every year, who ruled over all their country, and that all were obedient to that one”. They said they didn't have a king, but Trump is trying to set himself up as king.

These are the articles of war; write it down. This is where America gets it from. “If there come first any war upon the Romans or any of their confederates throughout all their dominion, The people of the Jews shall help them”: if Rome gets hit with something, the Jews must bring their military. “Neither shall they give any thing unto them that make war upon them, or aid them with victuals, weapons, money, or ships”: Israel could give no help, food, weapons, money or ships, to Rome's enemies. “but they shall keep their covenants”.

“In the same manner also, if war come first upon the nation of the Jews, the Romans shall help them with all their heart”. That is where the NATO articles come from: if you hit one NATO nation, all the other NATO nations must help. “According to these articles did the Romans make a covenant with the people of the Jews.”

“Howbeit if hereafter the one party or the other shall think meet to add or diminish any thing, they may do it at their pleasures”: see the trick bag? Today Trump bombs Iran, then tells NATO, y'all are supposed to come and help me. They say no: the articles say if any of us is attacked we help each other, and Iran did not attack America; America attacked Iran. So Spain said no, Germany said no, France said no, Britain said no, because you're wrong.

“For my people is foolish, they have not known me; they are sottish children”. Sottish means dull, stupid, senseless or foolish, often by habitual drunkenness. “and they have none understanding: they are wise to do evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.” Our people are wise to do evil.

Iran let all the blacks go, and the payback is a dumb black brother rapping and black women dancing, saying we did World War I and World War II, Iran, we ain't scared of you. This is the stupidity of black people, why nobody will ever respect black women and dumb black men rappers. Malcolm said, never let your oppressor tell you who your enemy is. But our people in the military have bought in for a check, willing to sacrifice their lives for money and take down the people that said, you're already oppressed, get out of here. This is why God calls our people sottish, a bunch of dumb asses, stupid, and why we get no respect. Black women, why are we the most unprotected? Because you're stupid, always shaking your behind.

Three black women would not pay for their luggage on a Frontier Airlines flight, and every passenger had to get off the plane; they were arrested, and in handcuffs one of them twerked. Where do black women get twerking from? A female gorilla in heat shaking her behind to seduce her mate: that is twerking.

“Behold, this have I found, saith the preacher, counting one by one”: “one man among a thousand have I found; but a woman among all those have I not found.” Solomon found one man among a thousand that sought after the Lord, but not a woman. Why? Because all his wives were idolaters. He married a thousand, 700 wives and 300 concubines, and not one of them sought to serve the Lord. Women are prone to idolatry, geared toward any sinful act, and that is why they need a man to say, not that way, go this way.

Very few black women have the intellect to deal in society, and Joy Reid is one: she told the smug Edomite that the Iran hostage crisis came because America overthrew Mosaddegh, Iran's elected leader, over BP's oil, and imposed the Shah, who brutally repressed the people for 26 years. It was never that they hate our freedoms. And anytime Esau uses the talking point black-on-black crime, remind them of the atom bomb, of Gaza, of what they do in Lebanon, of Tulsa, Oklahoma, of Lake Lanier. When it comes to killing and murder, they are at the top; you can't compare them to Pookie and Ray Ray.

Gaddafi was murdered under Obama, with Hillary working with him, and she laughed: we came, we saw, he died. “We have made a covenant with death”: that is the white man. “and with hell are we at agreement”: the hellish conditions, and people agree with it. “for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves”: lies and falsehood like democracy and Christianity. That is what our people do.

Captain Ibrahim Traoré, president of Burkina Faso, says it: democracy is not for us; democracy kills. Look at Libya: under Gaddafi water was free, and when people got married they received benefits. Today Libyans walk around with jerrycans looking for water. Everywhere they want to install democracy in the world, it is in blood. Democracy is slavery. We have to start to use our spiritual eyes with the word of God.

“And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon”: that is Lebanon. “but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king’s chamberlain their friend, desired peace”. Why did they want peace? “because their country was nourished by the king’s country.” One verse, and it speaks volumes.

Jamaica and Guyana ended their agreement with Cuba and sent the Cuban doctors home, the best doctors in the Caribbean, and Antigua is replacing them with a brigade from Ghana. Why? In 2024 the United States exported a record $5.47 billion in food to the Caribbean, roughly 50% to 55% of the region's food imports. America makes deals with countries: you're not allowed to grow your own food; we'll feed you. So when America says, get rid of all the Cuban doctors, they all say, yes, boss; yes, master; you give us food, master, your will is our command.

Bill Clinton forced Haiti to lower its tariffs on imported US rice. Haiti can grow its own rice, but America said, don't worry, we'll give you food, and Clinton admitted it destroyed Haitian rice production and helped his farmers in Arkansas. His apology changed nothing. If you depend on somebody for food, when America gets mad at you they cut all supplies, and your whole country starves. It's all a trick bag.

“say unto the prince of Tyrus”: this prince of Tyre is really speaking of Edom, a metaphor for America. “Because thine heart is lifted up, and thou hast said, I am a God, I sit in the seat of God, in the midst of the seas”: no other nation on earth ever did this, but America has, with her navy in the midst of the seas. That is how you know it is speaking of America. “yet thou art a man, and not God”: what man? The white man.

“Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee: With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures”. You read this and think it is something profound, but it is all in the negative. It is the wisdom of what Clinton did to Haiti: making them lower the tariff on rice from 50% to 3%, until Haiti, and the entire Caribbean, depended on America's food imports.

“By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches”: traffic means trade. “and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches.”

precepts.why:
